notes: LANDED kb/Work PB1123 (INSPECT arm) and PB5119 (the length). A format 3's REPLACING operands are identified with the TALLYING ones before the tally increments a counter they subscript: TALLYING ND ... REPLACING ALL A BY T(ND) reads T(1) (golden B leg). Item identification includes 'length evaluation for an occurs-depending group item' (§2023:14.6.4 step 6): from 2002 InspectBinder pins the DEPENDING ON object of a format 3's occurs-depending identifier-1 as a pre-op (StatementBinder.FreezeOdoExtentForStatement over FreezeOdoExtentBeforeRefMod), so TALLYING N ... REPLACING CHARACTERS BY "Z" over G (N 3, 'ABABAB') gives N 5 and ZZZBA (pb5119_format3_odo_length). At --std 85 the rule is GR17's, which fixes only the subscripting, so the REPLACING half takes the length at its own start and gives ZZZZZ (DialectBehavior.InspectFormat3LengthIdentifiedOnce, VCR row 7.57; pb5119_format3_odo_length_1985).
